No teaching moment

Education without a next step

People binge your posts and episodes, recognise the pattern, and then have to decide alone between a journal and a session. Most of them save the post and stay where they are.

No qualifier

Single sessions, booked cold

Anyone can book a session straight from the link. Nothing shows you beforehand who wants ongoing support and is ready to commit to it.

No list engine

Growth depends on today's post

With no free class capturing emails every day, new clients only appear when a post or an episode lands, and quiet weeks show up in your calendar.

The people who recognise themselves in your content but aren't ready to book a session have no gentle next step, so most of them take none.

My recommendation

A free trauma bond masterclass that sells a new starter programme and fills deeper 1:1 work

You already have the education, the Deprogramming Journal and paid sessions. What's missing is one free 60-minute class that explains why the bond feels so hard to break, offers a new Deprogramming Starter built from your Journal on the thank-you page, and invites the right people to apply for a new 1:1 package.

Fixes the missing teaching moment

One free class becomes the single front door in your bio. Every sign-up is an email you keep, and every attendee leaves understanding the trauma bond cycle before you ask for anything.

Fixes the missing qualifier

The replay page invites the people who want ongoing support to apply. You only speak with people who watched, stayed and told you what they need.

Puts your Journal to work

Your Deprogramming Journal becomes the base of a new Starter, offered at the exact moment people feel ready to begin.

The 95%*

Not ready for 1:1 yet

They join the free class, start the new Deprogramming Starter from the thank-you page, and keep learning from the follow-up emails at their own pace. They pay you while they build trust.

The qualified 5%

Ready for deeper support

They watch to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters for fit before your calendar, and three pre-call emails prepare them for the new 1:1 coaching package.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Sound familiar?

It isn't weakness. It's a bond that was built on purpose.

  • You've left, or you're thinking about leaving, a relationship that left you doubting yourself.
  • You know what happened, yet part of you still misses them or wants to go back.
  • You replay conversations and check their profile, then feel worse.
  • Friends say "just move on", and it isn't that simple.

Here's what you'll learn

Five things we'll cover in 60 minutes

01

What a trauma bond is

Why the pull can feel stronger after everything that happened, and why that isn't a sign you're weak.

02

The cycle, step by step

How idealisation, devaluation and the good moments in between keep the bond in place.

03

Why "just move on" fails

What makes no-contact so hard to hold, and what tends to make it easier.

04

First steps to deprogramming

The first stage of the approach Claire teaches, so you can start to trust your own read on things again.

05

Your next step

How the Deprogramming Starter and 1:1 coaching work, so you can choose the support that fits you.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"It isn't weakness"

Hook
"One of the most common things people say after a narcissistic relationship is: why do I still miss them?" (to camera, close framing, calm tone)
Body
"It isn't weakness. A trauma bond is built through a cycle: the highs, the lows, and the relief when things are good again. That cycle is what keeps the pull so strong. Once people understand it, the pull often starts to make sense." (simple on-screen text: highs, lows, relief)
CTA
"I explain the whole cycle, and the first steps to deprogramming it, in a free 60-minute class called Unhooked. Tap Sign up to save a seat."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Just move on"

Hook
"'Just move on.' If only it were that simple." (Claire, walking outdoors, natural light)
Body
"Advice like that skips the part that matters: why it's so hard to leave and stay gone. No-contact gets easier when the bond itself is understood, not just resisted." (captions on screen)
CTA
"In my free masterclass I walk through the cycle and the first deprogramming steps I teach. There's a replay if you can't make it live. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where do I start?"

Hook
"I get the same message every week: Claire, where do I even start?" (seated, warm light, holding phone with DMs blurred)
Body
"There are years of my posts and podcast episodes out there, and it can feel like a lot. So I've put the starting point into one free class. You'll learn what a trauma bond is, how the cycle works, and the first steps of deprogramming."
CTA
"It's called Unhooked. It's free, it's 60 minutes, and there's a replay. Tap Sign up."
